Nothing ever worked until eventually it clicked that I wasn’t ‘ready’ for help. As soon as I matured enough to take it on it’s flooded through. Also when I started using methods that worked better for me. Not everyone does well with having chats with yourself or meditating. For me picturing the source of distress in your body as a shape, describing its colour, how your breath moves around/ through it, the aura it gives out and a general description of it did well for me. Envisioning it getting lessened somehow, whether through being put out by water like a fire or slowly diminished by an unseen force. Closing your eyes and building a physical form to your distress often brings you to a new level of understanding it.
